output.output: [{"type":"text","text":"{\"skill_id\":\"deskclock.timer_5min_start\",\"body\":\"# Start a 5-minute timer in DeskClock app\\n\\n## Tested Environments\\n\\n- Android emulator\\n- Google DeskClock app (com.google.android.deskclock)\\n\\n## App Context\\n\\nDeskClock app is open on the Timer tab\\n\\n## Starting Context\\n\\nUser requests a 5-minute timer\\n\\n## Rules\\n\\n- Open the DeskClock app if not already open\\n- Navigate to the Timer tab if needed\\n- Find the '5m Timer' entry\\n- Tap the play/pause button (center_x=854, center_y=1667) to start the timer\\n- Verify the timer is running by checking the countdown display\\n\\n## Typical Flow\\n\\n1. smartphone_open_app with package_name='com.google.android.deskclock'\\n2. smartphone_list_elements to find the 5m Timer play/pause button\\n3. smartphone_tap_coordinates with x=854, y=1667\\n4. smartphone_take_screenshot or smartphone_list_elements to verify timer is running\\n\\n## Device Variants\\n\\n- Android emulator\\n- Pixel devices\\n\\n## Verification\\n\\n\\\"Confirm the timer shows a countdown (e.g., '04:51') and the play button has changed to a pause button\\\"\\n\\n## Failure Modes\\n\\n- Timer not starting: tap the play/pause button again\\n- Wrong timer selected: ensure you tap the button next to '5m Timer' not '5s Timer'\\n- App not responding: close and reopen the DeskClock app\"}"}]

arguments.why: Öffne die Uhr-App, um einen 5-Minuten-Timer zu starten.
Suche nach dem 5-Minuten-Timer und dem Start-Button.
